Landlords · tenants · small agencies · in French

Move-in and move-out inspection

For landlords, tenants and small letting agencies in France. One file per lease; standard rooms and items (floors, walls, ceilings, joinery, electrics, appliances, furniture for furnished lets), each rated in one tap (new, good, normal wear, damaged, out of order) with a comment and a photo. Meter readings and keys. At move-out, every item is compared with move-in, normal wear is told apart from damage, depreciation follows the grid of your lease if you enter it, and the deposit deadline is shown. Printable document to sign by hand. A drafting aid, not a certified document.
